title: LARGE LANGUAGE MODELS AND FORENSIC LINGUISTICS: NAVIGATING OPPORTUNITIES AND THREATS IN THE AGE OF GENERATIVE AI

bias_targets.methodology: Reviewing empirical evaluations of AI-text detectors to compare false positive misclassification rates between texts written by non-native English speakers (e.g., TOEFL essays) and native speakers, specifically analyzing how perplexity-based heuristics penalize constrained linguistic proficiency.
